lowering_gaps: core-form and core-form-known type and stop in prepared lowering with required lifetime does not outlive its target, with an inferred or a known length. The closure's parameter region comes from the callee's instantiated lifetime, and its body passes the parameter to a captured FnMut(&'a T, &'a T). The base dbeadba6 and 22902d20 fail the same way without any array pattern (d-ident), and a function item instead of the captured FnMut lowers (d-ident-fn).

not_graded.closure-ergonomic: a known-length closure take(w, |[a, b]| compare(a, b)): rustc accepts; types, lowering lifetime gap as core-form-known
not_graded.d-tuple: a tuple pattern in the closure parameter: rustc accepts; types, same lowering lifetime gap
not_graded.d-ident: take1(x, |a| compare(a, a)) without a pattern: rustc accepts; types, same lowering lifetime gap on dbeadba6, 22902d20 and wip1
not_graded.d-ident-fn: as d-ident with a function item cmp: rustc accepts; types and lowers
